title: Bias Beneath the Tone: Empirical Characterisation of Tone Bias in LLM-Driven UX Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Generating synthetic user-assistant dialogues with neutral and tone-conditioned prompts, then applying sentiment analysis via a fine-tuned DistilBERT model to assign weak labels, and training various classifiers (such as Logistic Regression, SVM, and neural memory networks) to detect systematic tonal skew in the LLM outputs.
